admission.justification: The coherent-review family needs catalogue rows to stay bound to the current comparison, because rows retained from another task could select intent outside the review on screen.

applicability: The shared catalogue hook when repository, master or leaf target changes.
conditions: The read target key must match the current target before rows can be returned.
Only the current mounted request sequence may complete the read.
exclusions: The hook does not create catalogue rows or choose a published dataset.
statement: Another task's catalogue entries are not exposed while the current task's catalogue read is pending.
